observed_architecture.task_close_atomicity: TaskSpec revision and run close are read and written through the same SQLite transaction when StateStore TaskSpec authority is present.
existing_guards: the close derives the plan digest from the authoritative initiative document before SQLite effects
the same initiative document is read again after SQLite effects and run-row readback but before commit
detected plan drift raises close-revision-drift and rolls back the SQLite transaction
replay of a committed receipt recomputes current against authoritative Registry truth

residual_race_reproduction.method: A transient hermetic pytest wrapper around StateStore.immediate changed initiative.current_plan after the close body returned from its final Registry guard but before the underlying SQLite context manager committed.
observed: the final in-transaction Registry guard saw the claimed plan revision
initiative.current_plan changed after that guard and before SQLite COMMIT
the first close committed the run as succeeded and returned current=true
an immediate authoritative receipt replay returned idempotent=true and current=false
residual_race_reproduction.classification: formally real and deterministically reproducible residual cross-domain race

shared_registry_writer_lock.benefit: Would serialize the close with writers that voluntarily acquire the same lock.
shared_registry_writer_lock.crash_safety: requires a new lock lifetime and recovery contract across filesystem and SQLite boundaries
shared_registry_writer_lock.deadlock_risk: non-zero because writer ordering would span independent Registry and StateStore effects
shared_registry_writer_lock.fatal_limit: Advisory locking cannot exclude the task's explicit non-cooperating Registry writer case.

narrow_write_gate.benefit: Could become effective only if every Registry mutation is forced through the gate.
narrow_write_gate.crash_safety: would require broker/permission ownership, recovery and availability semantics beyond this close path
narrow_write_gate.deadlock_risk: moves coordination into a new authority domain instead of removing one
narrow_write_gate.fatal_limit: The current repository and Git filesystem remain writable outside an advisory application gate.

retain_explicit_residual_risk.benefit: Preserves one SQLite truth domain and does not claim atomicity the filesystem cannot enforce.
retain_explicit_residual_risk.crash_safety: unchanged; SQLite close remains transactional and idempotent
retain_explicit_residual_risk.cost: A plan write landing in the final post-guard/pre-commit interval can make the just-committed receipt stale until authoritative readback exposes current=false.

single_effect_contract.reason: no-change introduces no new coordination or mutation effect

crash_recovery_contract.reason: no-change introduces no new coordination or recovery path

risk_classification.probability: low and scheduler-dependent in production; deterministic under instrumentation
risk_classification.semantic_impact: medium-high because the first return can transiently describe a receipt as current even though authoritative replay is already false
risk_classification.scope: initiative current_plan only when StateStore TaskSpec authority is active
risk_classification.accepted_reason: Eliminating the interval against non-cooperating filesystem writers requires an enforceable filesystem mutation authority, not an additional advisory lock inside complete_run.

required_final_verification: make validate on the exact final head
exact diff review proves no new runtime mutation logic
authoritative Bureau closeout readback binds the no-change evidence
